mines.mine_notes: Underground gold mine (Gwanda, Zimbabwe). 100%-basis production 76,213 oz; attributable 64% = 48,776 oz. 826,839 t milled (record, 98.7% of 838 ktpa capacity); grade not disclosed for 2025. H2 2025 affected by lower tonnages from higher-grade areas + electricity interruptions. Central Shaft commissioned. Mine-level costs not disclosed (group on-mine cost $1,263/oz, AISC $1,952/oz). FY26 guidance (100%): 72,000–76,500 oz, on-mine cost $1,500–1,700/oz, AISC $2,100–2,300/oz.

Oxide heap-leach operation; produced and sold 1,683 oz in 2025. Main Bilboes sulphide project in development (feasibility study / S-K 1300 TRS completed): P&P reserves 24.1 Mt @ 2.3 g/t (1,749 Koz) at 100% attributable. Development capex; solar optionality under study.
Exploration-stage project (acquired via Bilboes): M&I resources (excl. reserves) 7.9 Mt @ 1.71 g/t (436 Koz), Inferred 4.6 Mt @ 1.56 g/t (229 Koz), 100% attributable. No production.
Exploration-stage mining lease (acquired Nov 2022 from Bulawayo Mining for $8.25M via Motapa Mining Company UK Ltd/Arraskar). No production.

notes: Fiscal year ends 31 December. FY2025 group: Blanket 100%-basis 76,213 oz produced, 77,392 oz sold; Bilboes oxide 1,683 oz sold; consolidated gold sales 79,075 oz. Consolidated on-mine cost $1,263/oz, AISC $1,952/oz (29.6% above 2024 on higher admin/sustaining capex). 30% of Blanket's gold and 100% of Bilboes' gold sold to Fidelity at LBMA prices. Also listed on AIM and VFEX (Zimbabwe). Blanket reserve price US$1,877/oz (Dec 2023); Bilboes reserve gold price per TRS. Resources exclusive of reserves (Dec 31, 2025): Blanket M+I 495 Koz + Inferred 512 Koz (64%); Bilboes M+I 532 Koz + Inferred 984 Koz (100%); Maligreen M+I 436 Koz + Inferred 229 Koz (100%).
